mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees at Verona Area High School. Please note the air quality is currently at a moderate level of 55. We have a lovely Waxing Gibbous moon out tonight, though there are no visible space station passes to report.

The City has officially closed the submission period for the I Voted sticker contest. Verona students in grades K through 12 submitted their original artwork, and now the community will have the chance to vote on the winning designs starting July 28 through August 7.

There is plenty to do today, starting with the Dane County Farmers Market at the State Capitol. If you are looking for music, head over to Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, or the Wisconsin Brewing Company to enjoy some live performances.
In a notable incident from Sunday, July 13, police responded to a report of a vehicle stuck on a large rock, resulting in an O-W-I arrest for a 36-year-old Madison man.

Today's flavor is the delightful Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough. Please note that Culver's is currently closed, but they will reopen today at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is OREO Cookie Overload.
